objective: TAG1 lines need an exclamation mark appended to their value.
TAG3 lines need their value shouted (uppercased).
TAG5 lines need their value replaced outright with the word FIXED.
TAG6 lines need their value's first character replaced with X.
Strip the tag from every line once its fix is applied, wherever that tag appears in the file.
